verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's docs state it is accessible headlessly through its public APIs and MCP server, so people and AI agents can act on data outside the UI. Non-interactive automation is supported by private API keys with scopes, official server-side SDKs (Python, PHP, Ruby, Node), sandbox test accounts and documented rate-limit/Retry-After headers. missing for 10: an official CLI, CI-specific documentation or examples (e.g. pipeline setup), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
